arguments.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS total_amount_usd
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE ml.state = 'NY'
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of all transactions whose merchant location is in New York state, converted from cents to dollars.
assumptions: New York state is read as merchant_locations.state = 'NY' (the two-letter code), so city names are not used.
All transactions are included, whether labelled or not, and negative amounts are included in the sum as recorded.
The total covers the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
